entitlements.explanation: This instrument provides no monetary compensation for delay. Cash arises only for cancellation and denied boarding. The beyond-carrier-control exemption applies independently on the evidence.
Block time 165 minutes falls in the over-2½-to-5-hour band, so the three-hour threshold applies and the 420-minute delay exceeds it.
Delay communicated more than 24 hours ahead, exceeds six hours, and the 21:10 scheduled departure falls inside the 20:00–03:00 window.
Domestic flight expected to be delayed beyond six hours.

cause_assessment.note: trigger_type is operational context, never a legal verdict. These facts are required.

cause_comparison.description: Same incident recomputed as a cancellation caused by crew rostering.

alternative.note: Internal cause, so no exemption applies and cash becomes payable.

excluded_rules.reason: Reported February 2026 amendment to CAR Series M Part II moved the window from 24 to 48 hours.
